description: COVID-GM-RESCORE-01 diagnostic (non-scoring, labelled): the first-look probe of 'one import too few'. greg_mortimer_2020 with the explicit seed's count raised to 3 -- does a fatter import tail rescue ignition without touching transmission machinery? Anchored at theta 2.37e11 x hygiene_cycle x the same 50 seeds @20200205 so every cell pairs seed-for-seed against the scoring row at the anchor. Diagnostic only: no anchor is re-scored on it and it admits no tuning; it separates 'the voyage needed more than one introduction' from 'the transmission regime is dead'.
supersedes: nothing: it is the declared diagnostic inside COVID-GM-RESCORE-01, not a re-screening
prerequisites: covid_gm_rescore_v1 scoring design (this task): same scenario, seeds, and baseline arm; the delta between this design's row and the anchor row is the import-tail marginal.
NORO-HAND-PRACTICE-01 (PR #804): hygiene_cycle baseline as on the scoring design.

cell_conditioning.note: Identical to the scoring design except imports is 3: one seed entry with count 3 (three co-primary passengers boarding infected at epoch 0, infection_age 0.0) instead of the declared 1. Everything else -- SOP-017 day 8-27, day-20 universal screen, dwell_weighted, declared voyage -- is the scenario record verbatim.

arms.note: Baseline arm only (empty overrides; the shipped hand line). The probe is an import-count question, not a hand-arm question.

cells_note: 1 Theta x 1 arm x 50 seeds = 50 cells (seeds 20200205-20200254, identical to the scoring design's seed block). Cell order: indices 0-49 = theta 2.37e11 x hygiene_cycle x seed order.

metrics: P(takeoff >=10 recorded onsets) at 3 imports vs the scoring design's 1-import anchor row
campaign_positives median + q05-q95 vs H1's 128, takeoff-conditional positives, asymptomatic_share -- same reads as the scoring readout
seed-paired delta vs the scoring row on (theta 2.37e11, seed): does tripling imports move P(takeoff) materially, and does the conditional count move with it
freeze.verdict_grammar: Diagnostic readout only -- no verdict class. 'imports rescue' = P(takeoff) lifts materially AND the takeoff-conditional campaign_positives median moves toward 128; 'ignition fixed, size still wrong' = takeoff up but positives stay low; 'regime dead' = P(takeoff) ~ 0 even at 3 imports.

admissibility.note: Labelled diagnostic, not a scoring row: GM's record declares one import and the as-declared cell is the scoring row; this cell measures the import-count sensitivity around it.
audit_invariants: delivery.hand_reservoir_mode echoes hygiene_cycle on every payload.
seed_ring.seed_spec.count == 3 (the probe) with infection_age_days 0.0 and role passenger; seeded_count == 3.
cell pairing to the scoring rows keyed on (theta, seed) -- the same seeds in both files.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_gm_rescore_v1_imports3, STRIDE 1, ARRAY_SIZE 50 -- runs only on the author's go-ahead after the scoring canary, per the campaign gate.
